items.headline: Ten new single-family home permits issued on Aldeia Drive
items.summary: The city issued 10 separate building permits for new single-family home construction on Aldeia Dr, with declared permit valuations ranging from about $424,925 to $641,692 per permit. One of the permits, for the address at 5 Aldeia Drive, lists 2 as the source-reported dwelling-unit count, though this field can differ from the actual building description.

items.headline: Peery Park plan may add offices, R&D space, housing
items.summary: A Planning Commission special study session was scheduled for October 12 to review a proposed amendment to the Peery Park Specific Plan that would increase office and research-and-development square footage and residential unit counts, and allow relocation of the Libby Water Tower; the same meeting was set to take public comments on the scope of a supplemental environmental review of the 2016 plan EIR.
